data.body: Coordination note (2026-09-07): open bug prenatal-maudlin-seahorse (dbe7-d957-e5da-49dd, priority 1, "duplicate ticket creation is detectable but nothing aggregates or alarms on it") works the same area this story re-enables: the create-time duplicate journal (`recent-creates.json`, the `duplicate_warning` path in `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py`). If that bug lands first, this story keeps its aggregation and builds the journal beside it; if this story lands first, that bug builds on the re-enabled journal. Neither may build on the enrichment queue this story deletes (`rebar.llm.enrich_drain`, `maybe_drain` at `event_append.py:385-387` and `push.py:590-596`). Whoever lands second rebases and re-runs `make verify`.
